messages:
Acme Integrations: hitting a function-calling validation error in prod after the 3/15 rollout. Client sees 422 + schema_validation_error. Request ID: req_0a1b2c3d4e. Error: "Invalid enum value for summary_type: "wide""
Maya (Support): sorry — can you paste the original model response (the function call payload) and the function schema you registered? also any curl you used to reproduce?
Acme Integrations: pasted below. function schema expects summary_type enum ["brief", "detailed"] but model returned "wide". This started after we switched to redwood/model-variant:v2. Logs attached show validation fail.
Acme Integrations: ```json
{"name":"summarize","parameters":{ "type":"object","properties":{"text":{"type":"string"},"summary_type":{"type":"string","enum":["brief","detailed"]}},"required":["text","summary_type"]}}
```
Acme Integrations: model returned (as text arg string):
```json
{"name":"summarize","arguments":"{\"text\":\"...long article...\", \\"summary_type\":\"wide\"}"}
```
Alex (SDK): thanks — can you run a minimal curl that hits our API and include X-RW-REQUEST-ID? here's a suggested repro (replace $KEY):
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat/completions \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -H "Accept: application/json" \n  -H "X-RW-REQUEST-ID: req_0a1b2c3d4e" \n  -d '{
    "model":"redwood/model-variant:v2",
    "messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Summarize the article"}],
    "function_call": {"name":"summarize"},
    "functions":[
      {"name":"summarize","parameters":{ "type":"object","properties":{"text":{"type":"string"},"summary_type":{"type":"string","enum":["brief","detailed"]}},"required":["text","summary_type"]}}
    ]
  }'
```
Devin (Runtime): I pulled the raw logs for req_0a1b2c3d4e from the serving shard. We see the model emitted the arguments as a string (quoted JSON) and summary_type value "wide". Validation happens in the platform after parsing and fails. Kernel/runtime latency looked normal. Excerpt:
```
[2028-03-15T14:22:11.123Z] [req=req_0a1b2c3d4e] model-output: {"name":"summarize","arguments":"{\"text\":\"...\",\"summary_type\":\"wide\"}"}
[2028-03-15T14:22:11.130Z] [req=req_0a1b2c3d4e] validation: ERROR Invalid enum value for summary_type: "wide"
```
Maya (Support): can you also attach the debug bundle? I'll generate one if you don't have it. Support-bot, please create a debug bundle for req_0a1b2c3d4e and include model logs + kernel traces + request metadata.
support-bot: debug bundle created: dbg_6f7e8d9a; expires in 72h. Link: https://internal.redwood/debug/dbg_6f7e8d9a
Acme Integrations: grabbed it. uploaded curl output and the minimal repro. One more note: when we repro locally against older variant redwood/model-variant:v1 the model returns "brief" as expected. So this seems model-variant-specific.
Alex (SDK): two possibilities: model prompt/regression introduced a new preferred tokenization for the enum, or the model started outputting freeform synonyms. We should treat enum mismatches gracefully in SDK for function-calls (tolerate known synonyms or map). For the server side, we shouldn't 422 if parsing can coerce (e.g., map "wide" -> "detailed" if configured).
Devin (Runtime): agree. For immediate mitigation: we can add a fallback that attempts to map unknown enum strings via a small normalization table before validation. I'll open a patch for canary that logs mapping decisions.
Jen (SRE): can we scope impact? How many requests failed since the rollout? Devin: about 62 fails in last 3 hours across 3 tenants (based on enum validation error metric). Latency unaffected.
Maya (Support): I'll notify the customers and provide the debug bundle link and repro curl. Message to customers: "We have a repro and are rolling a targeted fix; meanwhile you can pin model to v1 as a workaround."
Alex (SDK): ps — include this quick local workaround in our SDK: if function call parse fails with enum mismatch and the function args is a string, attempt JSON.parse and then normalize enum values before throwing. I'll draft a PR.
Acme Integrations: appreciated. We'll keep the tenant on v1 for now and share any more examples if they appear. Thanks everyone :pray:
